questions.question: What does the term 'molarity' describe in chemistry?
choices: Which famous structure was built in the Middle Ages as a symbol of the power and influence of the church?

The Cologne Cathedral is an outstanding example of Gothic architecture and was built over several centuries, starting in 1248. It is considered an important landmark and symbol of Christianity in medieval Germany.
Which food is an important source of carbohydrates?
Rice is a staple food in many cultures and contains a high amount of carbohydrates, serving as a primary source of energy. In contrast, chicken, cheese, and salmon are protein-rich foods.
questions.explanation: Molarity is a measure of the concentration of a solution and indicates how many moles of a dissolved substance are contained in one liter of solution. This is important for chemical reactions as it determines the ratios of reactants.

questions.question: Which of the following animals belongs to the order of primates?
choices: Which of these island nations is known for its significant role in international trade and its strategic location in the Indian Ocean?

Mauritius is located in the Indian Ocean and has become an important trading center. Its geographical location provides easy access to international sea routes, promoting trade and attracting tourism.
Which country hosted the 2018 FIFA World Cup?
The 2018 FIFA World Cup took place in Russia and was the first World Cup held in Eastern Europe. France won the tournament, securing its second World Cup title.
questions.explanation: Primates are an order of mammals that include, among others, monkeys, humans, and lemurs. The chimpanzee is a close relative of humans and plays a significant role in understanding the evolutionary development of primates.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct Spanish translation for 'thank you'?
questions.explanation: The correct translation for 'thank you' in Spanish is 'gracias'. The other options have different meanings; 'por favor' means 'please', 'de nada' means 'you're welcome', and 'hasta luego' means 'see you later'.

questions.question: Welches der folgenden Tiere gehört zur Ordnung der Primaten?
questions.explanation: Primaten sind eine Ordnung von Säugetieren, zu denen unter anderem Affen, Menschen und Lemuren gehören. Der Schimpanse ist ein enger Verwandter des Menschen und spielt eine wichtige Rolle im Verständnis der evolutionären Entwicklung der Primaten.

questions.question: Welcher dieser Inselstaaten ist bekannt für seine bedeutende Rolle im internationalen Handel und seine strategische Lage im Indischen Ozean?
questions.explanation: Mauritius liegt im Indischen Ozean und hat sich zu einem wichtigen Handelszentrum entwickelt. Die geografische Lage ermöglicht einen einfachen Zugang zu internationalen Seewegen, was den Handel fördert und den Tourismus anzieht.

questions.question: Welches Land war Gastgeber der Fußball-Weltmeisterschaft 2018?
questions.explanation: Die Fußball-Weltmeisterschaft 2018 fand in Russland statt und war die erste WM, die in Osteuropa ausgetragen wurde. Frankreich gewann das Turnier und sicherte sich seinen zweiten Weltmeistertitel.
